description: Backend: Add Cognito group management service and admin endpoints. Create endpoints for listing, adding, and removing users from Cognito groups. Update auth-verify to auto-add new users to patient group.
steps: Create /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/shared/services/cognitoGroupService.ts with functions: addUserToGroup(username, groupName), removeUserFromGroup(username, groupName), listUserGroups(username) using AWS SDK AdminAddUserToGroupCommand, AdminRemoveUserFromGroupCommand, AdminListGroupsForUserCommand

Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-manage-user-groups.ts with three exported handlers: listUserGroups (GET), addUserToGroup (POST), removeUserFromGroup (DELETE). Follow admin-list-partners.ts pattern with verifyAdminToken()

Add IAM permissions to serverless.yml provider.iam.role.statements: cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup, cognito-idp:AdminRemoveUserFromGroup, cognito-idp:AdminListGroupsForUser, cognito-idp:AdminListUsers

Add function definitions to serverless.yml for the three new handlers: AdminListUserGroups (GET /api/admin/users/{userId}/groups), AdminAddUserToGroup (POST /api/admin/users/{userId}/groups), AdminRemoveUserFromGroup (DELETE /api/admin/users/{userId}/groups/{groupName})
Modify /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/auth-verify.ts to call addUserToGroup(phoneNumber, 'patient') after creating new user profile (around line 180 where isNewUser is set)
Run npm run type-check in backend repo to verify no TypeScript errors
Update /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-landing/.agents/specs/unified-auth/tasks.md to mark TASK-2.2, TASK-2.5, TASK-2.6 as complete
acceptance_criteria: npm run type-check passes with no errors
serverless.yml has IAM permissions for Cognito group operations
Three new handlers exist and follow admin endpoint pattern
findings: Added moovv_admin to KnownRole. New user auto-assignment to patient group is fire-and-forget (logged on failure but doesn't block login). Physio group assignment on approval will require separate implementation when physio approval flow is updated.
